room_rent.note: Policy wording does not mention any room rent cap or eligibility criteria

icu.note: No ICU charge cap or eligibility mentioned in wording

copayment.note: No co-payment clause found in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: No explicit disease-wise or procedure sub-limits stated in wording; micro-insurance product may have SI-level caps not detailed here

deductible.note: No deductible mentioned in the policy wording

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: PED defined (36 months look-back for diagnosis/treatment) but waiting period duration for coverage not explicitly stated in wording

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific waiting period defined in clause 2.1.49 as up to 36 months but no named disease list or specific duration provided in this wording

maternity.note: Inbuilt under Benefit 1; covers normal delivery, C-section, miscarriage, abortion due to accident/emergency; only first two living children; pre/post-natal if hospitalised; 9-month waiting period

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus defined in clause 2.1.9 but no rate or maximum percentage stated in wording

restoration.note: Reinstatement of full SI available once per Cover Period; reinstated amount usable only after SI exhausted; not for same illness/injury already claimed; available inbuilt or as optional add-on at inception/renewal or mid-term on payment of additional premium

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 1 day immediately prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 5 days after discharge

day_care.note: Day care covered only for procedures listed in Annexure-I

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined but not listed as a covered benefit under Benefit 1

ayush.note: AYUSH treatments covered under Benefit 3.1.6 up to SI at AYUSH hospitals; admissible only if in-patient care claim is also admissible

organ_donor.note: Donor treatment expenses explicitly excluded under clause 4.2(c)(x)

ambulance.note: Ambulance listed as a non-medical excluded item in Annexure II List-I; no ambulance benefit stated

modern_treatments.note: Advanced technology methods covered under Benefit 3.1.1/3.1.2 for specific listed procedures: robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, deep brain stimulation, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy (haematological)

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded per Annexure II

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only; overseas treatment excluded

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: 30-day free-look from receipt of policy document; not available at renewal

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Donor organ expenses, OPD treatment, external congenital anomalies, non-network hospitals only, RMO/surcharges, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, non-allopathic (except AYUSH inbuilt)

optional_riders.display: Reinstatement of SI (add-on at inception/renewal or mid-term); Personal Accident benefit (Benefit 2) optional
